gloss: smooth sweet bean paste; strained red bean paste

definitions.gloss: smooth sweet bean paste; strained red bean paste
definitions.explanation: Sweet red bean paste (あんこ) that has been strained to remove the bean skins, resulting in a completely smooth, fine-textured paste.

examples.japanese: こしあんの{羊羹|ようかん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought yokan made with smooth bean paste.

examples.japanese: こしあんは{舌触|したざわ}りがなめらかだ。
examples.english: Smooth bean paste has a silky texture.

examples.japanese: こしあんを{作|つく}るには、{小豆|あずき}を{煮|に}てから{裏漉|うらご}しする{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To make smooth bean paste, you need to boil azuki beans and then strain them.

notes:
The name comes from {漉|こ}す (to strain) + あん (sweet bean paste). Made by pressing cooked {小豆|あずき} beans through a sieve to remove the skins, then sweetening the resulting smooth paste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こしあんの{羊羹|ようかん}: yokan with smooth bean paste
- こしあんの{饅頭|まんじゅう}: manju with smooth bean paste
- こしあんの{最中|もなか}: monaka with smooth bean paste
- こしあんのたい{焼|や}き: taiyaki with smooth bean paste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {粒|つぶ}あん: chunky bean paste — beans are only partially mashed, retaining texture
- The こしあん vs {粒|つぶ}あん preference is a common conversation topic in Japan. Generally, こしあん is considered more refined and is preferred in many traditional {和菓子|わがし}

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {漉|こ}しあん or {漉|こ}し{餡|あん}.

RELATED WORDS:
- あんこ: sweet bean paste (general term)
- {小豆|あずき}: azuki beans
- {粒|つぶ}あん: chunky bean paste
- {白|しろ}あん: white bean paste (made from white beans)
